item.title: McNair enjoying first book’s success
item.description: Although Bill McNair retired several years ago from his job as recreation director in Baldwin County, he’s not sitting back and watching life go by.

item.title: RICH: Remembering Gavin
item.description: From the oven, I pulled out a peach cobbler that bubbled and popped beautifully. Outside, spring had come calling to resurrect what Winter had lulled to sleep. The trees and shrubs were a lovely green and almost in full growth.

item.title: Plant explodes, catches fire in Greensboro
item.description: A massive explosion that could be heard for several miles around Greensboro late Sunday afternoon later led to a breakout of several fires at a local industrial plant, authorities say.

item.title: Local man accused of assaulting his girlfriend

item.title: MCCLURE: More problems with the revenue office
item.description: Most owners of electric vehicles know or are aware of the Alternative Fuel Tax that they are required to pay every year, on your birthday.

item.title: CHANCEY: Reckless abandon characterizes rock-solid faith in God
item.description: On Oct. 14, 2012, Australian skydiver and extreme sportsman Felix Baumgartner rode a helium balloon-lifted capsule nearly 24 miles into the stratosphere and then stepped out the door and plummeted toward earth.
